title: FAQ for New and Returning Players
summary: Questions new and returning players often ask.

breadcrumb.text: FAQ for New and Returning Players

blocks.text: Q. Which episode is the server on?
A. See the [LINK:roadmap_current|Current Server Stage] page for the NEED server's current progress.
Q. What should I do first?
A. Check the Server Roadmap first, then use the Content Guide and the Equipment Guide to plan how to progress.
Q. Where do I get equipment?
A. Equipment drops from many kinds of content, such as Memorial Dungeons, regular dungeons and Illusion Dungeons. See [LINK:equipment_content|Equipment by Content] for details.
Q. Where do I enter Memorial Dungeons?
A. The Warp Helper takes you to most Memorial Dungeons. See the Content Guide for details.
Q. Are costumes shared across my account?
A. Register a costume in the Costume Album and unlock the account wardrobe, and every character on the same account can use it.
Q. What is the account unlock?
A. It opens your registered costumes to the other characters on your account. Unlocking the account costs Zeny.
Q. How do I get costumes?
A. From field hunting, boss monsters, events, Silvervine Fruit exchanges and more.
Q. Where do I get Shadow Gear?
A. Shadow Gear is added step by step through Lucky Egg updates.
Q. Are Enchant Stones shared across my account?
A. No. Enchant Stones are registered and managed per character.
Q. Can I get a specific costume directly?
A. Yes. Spend 300 Costume Coins to choose the costume with the album number you want.

blocks.title: More questions
blocks.text: If your question is not here, see the related guide pages or contact the staff.
